review_candidates.description: Menezia recherche des téléprospecteurs freelances pour développer son activité auprès des artisans. Débutants acceptés : une formation initiale est prévue pour découvrir nos services, notre méthode de prospection et notre fonctionnement. Nous accompagnons les entreprises dans leur marketing digital : création de sites web, référencement SEO, campagnes Google Ads et Meta Ads, gestion des réseaux sociaux. Votre mission Contacter des prospects, identifier leurs besoins et prendre des rendez-vous qualifiés pour notre équipe commerciale. Nos commerciaux prennent ensuite le relais pour présenter les offres et conclure les ventes. Vous vous concentrez sur la prospection et la prise de rendez-vous. Organisation et accompagnement • Activité 100 % à distance. • Horaires libres : vous choisissez votre organisation et le temps consacré à votre activité. • Formation initiale à nos services et à notre méthode de prospection. • Fichiers de prospects mis à disposition. • Outil d’appel disponible si nécessaire, avec la possibilité d’utiliser le vôtre. • Accompagnement disponible pour vous aider à démarrer, tout en conservant votre autonomie. Rémunération La rémunération est uniquement à la commission au démarrage, sans fixe ni minimum garanti. Vous percevez entre 100 € et 200 € par vente conclue par notre équipe commerciale à partir de vos rendez-vous, selon l’offre vendue et le barème applicable. La prise d’un rendez-vous seule ne donne pas lieu à une commission. Le potentiel de commissions est de 500 € à 4 000 € par mois, voire davantage selon les résultats. Cette fourchette est indicative et ne constitue pas une promesse de revenus : vos gains dépendent des ventes issues de vos rendez-vous et peuvent être nuls en l’absence de vente. Profil recherché • Débutant motivé ou téléprospecteur expérimenté. • À l’aise au téléphone et capable d’échanger clairement en français. • Autonome, sérieux et persévérant. • Bonne capacité d’écoute et envie d’apprendre. Statut indépendant Cette mission s’effectue dans le cadre d’une collaboration commerciale indépendante, sans contrat de travail salarié. Vous devez disposer d’un statut permettant de facturer vos prestations : micro-entreprise, société ou structure équivalente dans votre pays. Si vous n’avez pas encore de structure, vous pouvez postuler à condition d’être prêt à en créer une pour démarrer la collaboration. Les candidatures depuis l’étranger sont également les bienvenues, sous réserve de pouvoir prospecter le marché français en français. Envie de rejoindre Menezia ? Envoyez votre candidature avec une courte présentation de votre parcours et de votre motivation. Aucune expérience préalable en téléprospection n’est exigée.

review_candidates.title: Tax Accountant
review_candidates.description: About the role We are seeking an experienced and detail-focused Senior Australian Tax Accountant to review and quality-check tax work prepared by junior tax accountants in India for TaxMode, an Australian accounting and advisory practice. The role will help ensure accurate, complete, compliant, and client-ready tax work across individual, business, trust, property, and related accounting matters. This is a senior all-rounder role requiring approximately 3–5 years of relevant Australian tax-accounting experience. The successful candidate will be confident using Xero, able to take ownership of matters from review through to completion, and comfortable liaising with the founder, clients, and offshore team members. The role will also contribute to improving TaxMode’s processes, checklists, workflows, and quality standards. Key responsibilities   Technical review and tax compliance: review individual, sole trader, company, trust, and property-investment tax returns, workpapers, financial statements, BAS, IAS, PAYG, and supporting documents prepared by junior accountants; identify errors, missing information, technical risks, and inconsistencies; prepare or finalise work where required; and escalate complex matters before advice or lodgement. Team coordination and process improvement: provide clear review feedback; track outstanding items and deadlines; liaise with the founder, clients, and offshore team; maintain checklists and workpapers; identify recurring issues; and improve TaxMode’s preparation and review procedures. Essential experience   Strong working knowledge of Australian tax and compliance processes; hands-on Xero experience; excellent attention to detail; accurate review of numbers and documentation; ability to take ownership and meet deadlines; professional written and verbal English; clear communication with remote teams and clients; sound organisation; and discretion with confidential information. Desirable experience   Experience with Xero Tax, Xero Practice Manager, FYI, BGL, HandiSoft, MYOB, or comparable systems; BAS, IAS, payroll, bookkeeping, capital gains tax, rental properties, negative gearing, depreciation, ASIC agent services, SMSF compliance, or tax-planning work; and experience creating SOPs, checklists, or training materials. Training and support   The client will provide onboarding to TaxMode’s systems, client profiles, review standards, approval workflows, templates, and reporting formats. The successful candidate will be expected to give practical feedback and guidance to junior accountants so that work quality improves consistently over time. Role boundaries   The role will provide senior review, preparation, coordination, and process support. Final approval, regulated tax advice, signing, and lodgement authority will remain subject to TaxMode’s Registered Tax Agent arrangements, the candidate’s qualifications and authority, and applicable Australian requirements. Complex or high-risk matters must be escalated before advice is issued or work is lodged.

review_candidates.description: Company: EN Global Education Ltd Position Title: Student Counselor (UK Universities) Department: Student Counseling & Recruitment Employment Type: Full-time Work Location: On-site / Office-based About EN Global Education Ltd EN Global Education Ltd is an international student recruitment and educational consultancy firm. We assist international students in securing admissions and navigating entry requirements for partner universities across the UK. Our team guides applicants through course selection, application processes, documentation, and visa compliance. Role Summary We are seeking an experienced Student Counselor (UK Higher Education) to advise and support students aiming to pursue undergraduate and postgraduate degrees in the UK. In this role, you will conduct one-on-one consultations, evaluate academic profiles, recommend suitable courses and institutions, manage university application submissions, and support applicants through the UK Student Visa (CAS) process. You will also maintain up-to-date knowledge of UKVI compliance guidelines and institutional recruitment requirements. Key ResponsibilitiesStudent Advisory & Recruitment Conduct initial profile evaluations, reviewing academic transcripts, English language proficiency scores (e.g., IELTS, PTE, OIETC), and career goals to identify suitable UK universities and courses. Provide accurate information on UK entry requirements, tuition fees, scholarships, and living costs. Manage student inquiries generated via walk-ins, phone calls, digital campaigns, and educational fairs. Maintain regular follow-ups with prospects to guide them from initial inquiry through enrollment. Application & Admissions Management Assist students in compiling required admission documents, including Statement of Purpose (SOP)/Personal Statements, Academic CVs, and letters of recommendation. Submit applications through university portals or partner CRM channels and track application statuses. Prepare applicants for university Credibility Interviews and pre-CAS interviews. Communicate directly with university admissions teams to resolve queries and expedite offer letters. Visa & Compliance Assistance Advise conditional and unconditional offer holders on financial documentation, tuition fee deposits, and the Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) issuance process. Assist students with filling out online UK Student Visa applications, booking biometric appointments, and organizing supporting documents in line with UKVI requirements. Ensure all student files are maintained accurately in compliance with internal and UKVI data guidelines. Operations & Outreach Participate in university partner training sessions, webinars, and education fairs. Stay current on changes to UK immigration rules, post-study work routes (Graduate Route visa), and university entry updates. Collaborate with the marketing and branch operations teams to meet monthly and seasonal student recruitment targets. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Lead Conversion Rate: Percentage of assigned inquiries converted into submitted applications. Offer Acceptance Rate: Conversion of conditional/unconditional offers into firm acceptances and fee deposits. Visa Success Rate: Maintaining a strong visa approval rate through accurate compliance checks. SLA Adherence: Turnaround times for application processing, document checks, and student query responses. Qualifications & RequirementsEducation & Experience Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (degrees from UK or overseas universities are an advantage). 1–3 years of proven experience as a Student Counselor, Admissions Officer, or Educational Consultant focusing on UK higher education. Knowledge & Skills Strong understanding of the UK higher education system, UCAS policies, UKVI Student Visa requirements, and pre-CAS procedures. Excellent command of written and spoken English. Proficiency in office productivity tools (Microsoft Office Suite) and experience navigating CRM/admissions databases. Interpersonal and active listening skills with a customer-centric approach. Ability to manage multiple application deadlines under seasonal pressure. Compensation & Benefits Salary: Competitive / Negotiable based on experience. Incentives: Performance-based bonuses linked to successful recruitments and visa outcomes. Professional Development: Training directly conducted by UK university representatives. Benefits: Annual leave, festival bonuses, and career progression opportunities within the global network.

review_candidates.title: Staff Platform Engineer
review_candidates.description: We’re looking for a Platform Engineer to join our Platform team, which builds shared infrastructure and delivery tooling across Fliff’s products. The team is responsible for Cloud Core, CI/CD, Platform Security, and support triage. In this role, you’ll take ownership of our CI/CD platform and help it scale, making architectural decisions, evaluating trade-offs, and adapting to changing requirements and production challenges. Your work will shape how software delivery and infrastructure operate across the engineering organization. Responsibilities Own and evolve our CI/CD platform: GitHub Actions with self-hosted runners (RunsOn), plus an in-progress migration and refactor of our Jenkins setup ("Jenkins Next"). Build and maintain Infrastructure as Code across AWS using Terraform / Terragrunt / Terramate, following reusable component patterns (CloudPosse-style). Design secure-by-default delivery pipelines: branch protection and PR approval rulesets, secrets management (SOPS), and prod-approval flows for critical paths. Drive our move from IAM users and long-lived access keys toward IAM roles, and help close foundational security gaps (open ports, unmanaged credentials, missing guardrails). Work with Kubernetes (EKS), Helm, and ArgoCD, and support our observability stack (Grafana, Prometheus) and developer platform (Backstage). Review and improve existing components — Terraform, pipelines, AWS infra — not only build new ones, and raise the bar on how the team delivers. Share the support/triage load and help reduce it through better automation and tooling. Requirements Strong AWS experience and deep hands-on CI/CD expertise (GitHub Actions and/or Jenkins). Solid Infrastructure as Code background with Terraform (Terragrunt / Terramate a plus). Real Kubernetes / EKS experience, including Helm and GitOps (ArgoCD). A security-conscious mindset — comfortable reasoning about IAM, secrets, network exposure, and least-privilege access (a DevSecOps lean is a strong plus). The ability to design a solution, then adapt gracefully when constraints change ("now make it global", "now cost is the primary driver") — digging for context rather than getting flustered. Sound judgment on edge cases and incidents: traffic spikes 10x, a region goes down — how do you approach the change and handle the outage? Effective, deliberate use of AI tooling, with genuine understanding of what it produces and the ability to explain trade-offs it can't. We are a multinational company with our headquarters based in Philadelphia, and offices in New York, Austin, and Sofia, Bulgaria. Wherever we are in the world, we pride ourselves on being a close-knit, focused team that is welcoming and friendly, and the work that we do is always interesting and rewarding. Wherever we are in the world, we pride ourselves on being a close-knit, focused team that is: Welcoming and Friendly We want to reflect the diversity of the cities we serve. By creating an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive, we’ll make Fliff better for employees and customers alike. Lively and Creative We respect and value each other’s ideas, experience and expertise. There is no such thing as a bad idea; only ideas that are executed and ideas that are discarded after consideration. Stimulating and Rewarding We know bright minds love a challenge, and we understand your desire to see your hard work pay off. We’ll make sure your daily tasks align with your career ambitions as we grow together. Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Fliff is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. Join Our Team! If you're ready to be part of an exciting, innovative, and dynamic team, apply now to help shape the future of sports gaming with Fliff. IMPORTANT NOTICE: The privacy and security of applicant information is paramount and we take fraud attempts very seriously. Please note that Fliff will never ask for payment or personal financial information during the application process. All of our legitimate job opportunities can be found on our official career site (https://www.getfliff.com/careers). Please be cautious of communications and links that come from non-company email addresses (@getfliff.com), social media messaging platforms or unsolicited phone calls.

review_candidates.description: Job Description Summary GE Vernova befindet sich in einer Phase rasanten Wachstums und verstärkt derzeit seine Teams, baut neue auf und bringt die Branche auf die nächste Stufe. Werden Sie Teil unserer Mission! Bei GE Vernova Grid Solutions elektrifizieren wir die Welt mit fortschrittlichen Netztechnologien. Als führendes Unternehmen im Energiesektor ist es unser Ziel, den Übergang zu einem energieeffizienteren Stromnetz zu beschleunigen, um den Bedarf von morgen zu decken. Mit Fokus auf Wachstum und Nachhaltigkeit spielt GE Vernova Grid Solutions eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Integration erneuerbarer Energien in das Stromnetz und trägt so zur Klimaneutralität bei. Aufgrund unseres Wachstums suchen wir aktuell einen Site Civil Manager (m/f/d) für den Bereich „Construction & Commissioning“, der die Energiewende in Mitteleuropa mitgestalten möchte. Ihre Mission: Sie arbeiten in unserem komplexen HVDC- Projekt " BalWin4/ Lanwin1" (Nordsee) auf der Baustelle und koordinieren und überwachen die Hoch- und Tiefbauleistungen unserer Subunternehmer. Sie sind Teil des Site Management Teams und leiten das Civil- Team auf der Baustelle. Unsere Baustellen befinden sich in Deutschland. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie unseren Bereich “Construction & Commissioning” in Central Europe mit neuen Ideen aktiv mit! Job Description Ihre Aufgaben: Führen des Civil- Teams auf der Baustelle (Kleines Team 4-5 MA, bestehend aus Subunternehmern und GE-Mitarbeitern) Plankoordinierung und Arbeitsvorbereitung der jeweiligen Bauabschnitte gemeinsam mit dem Engineering und Projekt- Team Überwachen und Koordination der Bauausführung vor Ort, sodass diese den öffentlich-rechtlichen Vorschriften sowie den Entwürfen des Entwurfsverfassers entsprechen Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Arbeitssicherheitsanforderungen, Terminen & Kosten Qualitätskontrolle und Sicherstellung der Übereinstimmung von Ausführung und Planung, inkl. Dokumentation Bearbeitung von Mangelanzeigen Erkennen und Aufzeigen von Abweichungen und Nachtragspotential Teilnahme und Protokollierung von Baustellenbesprechungen und Abnahmebegehungen Führen des Bautagebuches für die Bauleistungen Ihre Profil: Abgeschlossenes Bauingenieurs- oder Architekturstudium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Bau- und Projektleitung, (vorzugsweise Tiefbau) Erfahrung in der fachlichen Führung eines Teams auf der Baustelle Umspannwerkserfahrung von Vorteil Durchsetzungsvermögen & Belastbarkeit im Umfeld eine komplexen Infrastrukturprojektes Erfahrungen in der Elektrotechnik sind ein Plus Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch Warum Sie bei uns arbeiten sollten: Bei GE Vernova stellen sich unsere Ingenieure jeder Herausforderung und streben stets nach der besten Lösung. Unsere Projekte sind einzigartig und spannend, und Sie sollten für jedes Projekt eine lösungsorientierte und positive Herangehensweise mitbringen, um Ihr Bestes zu geben. Umgeben von engagierten und loyalen Kollegen, können Sie, wenn Sie Ihren Einfallsreichtum und Ihren Wunsch, etwas zu bewegen, einbringen, an zukunftsweisenden und vielfältigen Projekten mitwirken und Ihren Beitrag zur Energiewende leisten. review_candidates.title: Site Activation Manager/Clinical Operations Manager_ Madrid/Spain. FSP
review_candidates.description: Description Site Activation Manager/Clinical Operations Manager_ Madrid/Spain. FSP Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress. Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape. Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need. Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know: Why Syneos Health We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program. We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life. We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress. Job Responsibilities This role is accountable for performance and compliance for assigned protocols in a country in compliance with ICH/GCP and country regulations, client policies and procedures, quality standards and adverse event reporting requirements internally and externally. The person is responsible for budget/finance aspects, for execution and oversight of clinical trial country submissions and approvals and to ensure Site Ready. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: Ownership of country and site budgets. Development, negotiation and completion of Clinical Trial Research Agreements (CTRA). Oversees and tracks clinical research-related payments. Payment reconciliation at study close-out. Oversees FCPA, DPS/OFAC, and maintenance of financial systems. Financial forecasting in conjunction with SCOM /other roles. Executes and oversees clinical trial country submissions and approvals for assigned protocols. Develops local language materials including local language Informed Consents and translations. Interacts with IRB/IEC and Regulatory Authority for assigned protocols. Manages country deliverables, timelines and results for assigned protocols to meet country commitments. Responsible for quality and compliance in assigned protocols in country. Contributes to the development of local SOPs. Oversees CTCs as applicable. Coordinates and liaises with CRM, CTC, CRA, (Finance and Legal if appropriate) to ensure country deliverables are obtained for submissions, budgets, CTRAs and local milestones. Collaborates closely with Headquarter to align country timelines for assigned protocols. Provides support and oversight to local vendors as applicable. Oversees and coordinates local processes, clinical and ancillary supplies management, importing and exporting requirements, supplies destruction, local electronic/hard copy filing, archiving and retention requirements, and insurance process management. Enters and updates country information in clinical and finance systems. Ownership of local regulatory and financial compliance. The position has a significant impact on how a country can deliver country-specific trial commitments and objectives especially during study start-up. Required to in/directly influence investigators, external partners and country operations to adhere to partners and country operations to adhere to budget targets and agreed payment timelines. Works in partnership internally with GCTO country operations, finance, regulatory affairs, pharmacovigilance, legal and regional operations, HQ functional areas and externally with vendors and sites, IRB/IECs and Regulatory Authorities in submission and approval related-interactions. Through continual interaction with local clinical team/s successfully delivers clinical and financial contracts within fair market value. Bachelor's Degree in Business Finance/ Administration/ Life Science or equivalent Health Care related experience 5 years of experience in clinical research or combined experience in Clinical Research and Finance/Business Expertise of core clinical systems, tools and metrics Excellent English skills Strong coordination and organizational skills skilled knowledge of budget and contract negotiations, local regulatory environment and submission and approval processes, and understanding of how these impact study start-up Ability to indirectly influence investigators, vendors, external partners and country managers to address and resolve issues, with minimal support from the SCOM or manager. Ability to make decisions independently with limited oversight from SCOM or manager. Requires strong understanding of local regulatory environment Ability to proactively develop risk management and mitigation plans in the country and resolve issues locally. Problem solving is essential to this position. Requires the ability to pro-actively identify issues and risks, analyze root cause, and propose solutions to problems and escalate to management as applicable. Specific examples of common problems include: 1) Issues in budget / CTRA negotiations, 2) Quality and compliance issues, 3) Regulatory and legal issues, and 4) issues related to functional area deliverables that could jeopardize protocol milestones. Strong communication, leadership, and negotiation skills as well as excellent influencing and training/mentoring skills, both written and verbal, in local language and English Ability to focus on multiple deliverables and protocols simultaneously is essential. Requires that the individual has ability to work effectively also in a remote virtual environment with a wide range of people Get to know Syneos Health Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients. No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health. http://www.syneoshealth.com Additional Information Tasks, duties, and responsibilities as listed in this job description are not exhaustive. The Company, at its sole discretion and with no prior notice, may assign other tasks, duties, and job responsibilities. Equivalent experience, skills, and/or education will also be considered so qualifications of incumbents may differ from those listed in the Job Description. The Company, at its sole discretion, will determine what constitutes as equivalent to the qualifications described above. Further, nothing contained herein should be construed to create an employment contract. Occasionally, required skills/experiences for jobs are expressed in brief terms. Any language contained herein is intended to fully comply with all obligations imposed by the legislation of each country in which it operates, including the implementation of the EU Equality Directive, in relation to the recruitment and employment of its employees. The Company is committed to compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, including the provision of reasonable accommodations, when appropriate, to assist employees or applicants to perform the essential functions of the job.
